CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust, CardKeyword.Innate }` (Apotheosis.cs:11-15) == both class attributes. These are CANONICAL keywords (set at construction), not upgrade-added ones, so the downgrade-rebuild hazard that hits aggression/apparition does not apply -- `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list apotheosis.

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Ancient, TargetType.Self)` (Apotheosis.cs:17-20) == cost 2 / SKILL / ANCIENT / SELF.

OnPlay.rationale: `foreach (allCard in Owner.PlayerCombatState.AllCards) if (allCard != this && allCard.IsUpgradable) CardCmd.Upgrade(allCard)` (Apotheosis.cs:24-30) == `for card in ctx.player.all_cards: if card is not self and card.is_upgradable: card.upgrade()`. `is_upgradable` mirrors `CardModel.IsUpgradable` exactly (`upgrade_level < max_upgrade_level`, cards/base.py:167-170), so statuses/curses with MaxUpgradeLevel 0 are skipped on both sides. `CardCmd.Upgrade` adds only a deck-history entry and VFX on top of `UpgradeInternal` (CardCmd.cs:266-311), neither of which is in scope.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (Apotheosis.cs:36) == `self._energy_cost -= 1` (2 -> 1). No clamp needed at this base cost.

guards.what: the `allCard != this` self-exclusion, and whether the two AllCards sets are the same set (Apotheosis.cs:26)
guards.rationale: C# `PlayerCombatState.AllCards` is `AllPiles.SelectMany(p => p.Cards)` (PlayerCombatState.cs:82) over Hand, Draw, Discard, Exhaust AND Play (PlayerCombatState.cs:70-80, quoted by docs/audit/seams/hook_dispatch.md:302-355); the sim's `all_cards` is `hand + draw_pile + discard_pile + exhaust_pile` (player.py:100-103) with no Play pile. They still agree here because the sim parks a non-Power card being played in the DISCARD pile for the duration of OnPlay (combat.py:452-454, the `_playing_card` limbo marker), so Apotheosis itself is in `all_cards` and is excluded by the same `is not self` test. DORMANT nuance: the sets diverge only when a POWER card is mid-play while Apotheosis resolves, because the sim removes Power cards from every pile for the duration (combat.py:452) while C# holds them in Play. That needs a nested play whose OUTER card is a Power and whose inner card is Apotheosis; no ported content does that today (Havoc/Beat Down/Mad Science auto-play from piles but are themselves Skills). It becomes live if any Power card is ported that auto-plays another card.
